Evidence, 2026-11-11 PST.
1. Live definitions read (describe-alarms; saved in session scratch): each hand-made alarm uses 3600 s periods, 3 of 3 evaluation, notBreaching, action arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:896586841071:bedrock-spend-cap-alerts, no OK action. Cache ratio: `IF(inp > 1000000, cache / inp, 1)` < 0.8. Unit cost: `IF(inv > 5, (inp*R_in + cache*R_cache + out*R_out)/1000000/inv, 0)` > the per-model threshold. The opus/sonnet rates and thresholds carry over unchanged; genai-prices confirms the AWS 5.5 per-token rates equal the 4.x rates the math used.
2. Change 3358 merged as b603c4544e8 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved; make verify rc=0: 21,107 + 218 passed). New file infra/terraform/monitoring_bedrock_cost.tf: alarms keyed by a locals map (opus = us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5, sonnet = us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5) targeting aws_sns_topic.bedrock_spend_cap_alerts, plus ok_actions as the repo's alarm contract requires. terraform validate passes. Haiku is not covered: no hand-made baseline existed.
3. `scripts/terraform_prod.py plan` from a worktree at origin/main b603c4544e8: 4 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy, only the 4 new alarms. Apply: "Apply complete! Resources: 4 added". A re-plan afterwards shows "No changes".
4. `aws cloudwatch delete-alarms` removed bedrock-cache-ratio-low-opus-4-8, bedrock-cache-ratio-low-sonnet-4-6, bedrock-unit-cost-high-opus-4-8 and bedrock-unit-cost-high-sonnet-4-6 at 2026-11-11 21:37 PST.
5. `describe-alarms --alarm-name-prefix bedrock-` at 21:37 PST: bedrock-cache-ratio-low-opus, bedrock-cache-ratio-low-sonnet, bedrock-unit-cost-high-opus and bedrock-unit-cost-high-sonnet are all INSUFFICIENT_DATA (new; no hourly datapoint yet); bedrock-spend-cap-lambda-{errors,liveness} are OK. None of the 4.x alarms remain.
